description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the FormatWithPassportType class in the OrangeHRM project. It sets up the test environment and verifies that the getFormattedValue method returns the expected string values for given inputs.

classes.name: FormatWithPassportTypeTest
classes.description: Test suite for the FormatWithPassportType class, verifying correct formatting of passport-related values.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating an instance of FormatWithPassportType.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that getFormattedValue returns 'Passport' for input 1 and 'Visa' for input 2.
